title: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2 — Step 4 offensive scoring research
project: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2
problem: Top Picks could explain model probability and matchup history but could not show the actual offensive football evidence behind scoring expectations.
root_cause: The detail layer had no field-level offense research router. Existing certified CFB sources already exposed exact-team current-season scoring, passing, rushing, yards/play, red-zone finishing, explosive-efficiency proxies, and completed-game scoring history, but Top Picks never assembled them.
patch: Add a descriptive field router that pulls core offense metrics from ESPN exact-team current-season statistics, recent scoring from completed ESPN team schedules, red-zone TD rate from certified NCAA tables, and an explicitly labeled explosive-efficiency proxy from certified NCAA passing/rushing efficiency tables. Render this only after a user taps a Top Pick.

repair.exact_failure: test_tapped_matchup_renders_open_three_part_dropdown omitted offense_research from its manually constructed detail payload
repair.patch: Forward-port the old unit-test detail fixture to include the existing Step-4 offense stub. Product/source/history/UI logic unchanged.

live_ncaa_alias_repair.root_cause: NCAA stat-table identity abbreviates South Florida as South Fla.; the shared safe matcher intentionally refuses that large string-length gap.
live_ncaa_alias_repair.patch: Add deterministic Step-4-only NCAA alias South Florida/USF -> south-fla. Shared fuzzy matching remains strict; all other team identities are unchanged.
